multiple_testing.family_definition: Both finite primary-indicator MK tests for every region with sufficient common complete years; no direction/significance/reliability selection.
multiple_testing.scope: Only this frozen fine pilot catalog; never a worldwide or coarse-grid family.

limitations: Provisional statistical screening; source QA and common spatial footprints remain unreviewed.
BH assumes independence or suitable positive dependence; spatial dependence has not been validated.
Worldwide-adjusted map classifications are separate from unchanged within-region analysis results.
No detected divergence does not establish environmental safety; opposing trends do not establish causation.
No missing observations are interpolated. Known low-coverage/rejected rows are excluded only in the analysis copy.
Grid cells without both primary indicators remain pending; global means are never assigned to cells.
Available-indicator diagnostics are not part of the paired worldwide family; their significance is exploratory across regions.
Fine pilot only; neighboring native model cells may be spatially dependent. Worldwide fine coverage remains pending.

jurisdictions.name: Chile
jurisdictions.uncertainty: Coarse geographic intersection; disputed boundaries and policy authority require source review.

limitations: Greenness is not ecosystem health; divergence does not establish degradation or causation.
Monthly inputs use equal-weight calendar-year means; default requires all 12 months. No imputation.
All indicators share valid calendar years; extra indicators can reduce the common record.
P-values and slope intervals assume independent annual observations. Residual lag-1 is only a screen, not a correction or proof of independence.
BH correction covers MK tests for indicators in this call, not regions or repeated exploratory analyses; it assumes independence or suitable positive dependence.
Confidence intervals are marginal, not simultaneous, prediction, or ecological-damage intervals.
Sensitivity checks assess direction, not significance stability or alternate spatial aggregation.
Source strings are supplied by the caller; NASA provenance, QA flags, spatial comparability and physical units must be verified upstream.

If any source label contains SYNTHETIC (case-insensitive), the entire result is marked synthetic_demo=true, including mixtures of real and synthetic sources; this is a label heuristic, not provenance verification.

Raw coverage uses supplied calendar years. Reliability uses contributing observations within final analysis bounds, including unusable interior years as gaps; unobserved endpoint years cannot be inferred.
Numerically constant series use a 100-epsilon relative tolerance across trend methods and residual checks; this is not an ecological effect-size threshold.
Available-indicator diagnostic only: paired regional screening is pending or insufficient; these p-values have not been adjusted across regions and must not color the divergence map.
